note: QwenImage21Pipeline(prompt, image=[...], output_resolution=64, latents=initial) on the pico folder in float64, use_kv_cache on, true_cfg_scale 1. Images: uint8 ((i * 7919 + 13) mod 256), i = row-major (y, x, channel) index. token_ids: one <|image_pad|> per image (expanded by the processor shim). Latents are packed (tokens, channels), token = h * latent_w + w. step_latents[i] = latents after scheduler step i; image (two_images only) = output_type 'pt' (C, H, W) in [0, 1]. resized: PIL resized a condition image. Floats: 8 significant digits.
